rules: No axes, scales, gradients or ordering that implies strength, boldness, gentleness, projection, similarity score or rank.
No dash characters anywhere (use commas and the word 'and').
Notes come only from the official pages listed per node; note words are not in quotation marks because none is a full verbatim sentence.
No bottles, logos or brand marks drawn; fragrance names appear as plain text only.

figures.layout: Two side-by-side panels of equal size. Left panel: one recipe card with an arrow pointing to a second, identical recipe card (same ingredient icons in the same places). Right panel: two different recipe cards; each has several ingredient icons, and two icons (a bergamot slice and a lavender sprig) appear on both cards, circled in the same accent colour. Icons carry no text.

labels.text: A clone tries to copy another fragrance's recipe.
An alternative is a different recipe sharing some ingredients.

content_sources: https://www.pairfum.com/should-you-buy-clone-perfume-dupes-and-copycat-fragrance/ (clone replicates, copies or imitates a fragrance)
https://www.dior.com/en_us/beauty/products/sauvage-eau-de-parfum-Y0785220.html (bergamot and lavender icons are notes Dior lists)
Alternative wording is the article's editorial definition
figures.caption: A clone tries to copy another fragrance's recipe. An alternative is its own recipe that shares a few of the same smells.
figures.alt: Two panels. On the left, a recipe card is copied into an identical card, labelled as a clone. On the right, two different recipe cards share a bergamot and a lavender icon, labelled as an alternative.

figures.layout: Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum in a central circle. Five equal-sized nodes evenly spaced around it on one circle, each joined to the centre by a line of identical length and weight, placed clockwise from the top in article order. Distance, size, colour and position carry no meaning. In each node: the fragrance name, a 'Shares' line in the accent colour and a 'Differs' line in neutral grey.
